title: A worked-out series page (eGFR, waist-to-height) whose screen draw moves while its read runs lands that read at the page's revision with nothing kept: the page shows failed, or empty, for a read the store threw away; key the page's read on the store's stamp (revision and draws), not the revision alone
evidence: Done 2026-11-14: RecordStore+Charts.swift chart() reads again when only the screen drawn moved during the engine call (stamp.revision unchanged, draws moved), for the owner and a joined read alike, so a page lands only a read current for the screen drawn; a moved revision still returns as before and the page's .task(id: revision) asks again. Test: MetricReadTests testAReadWhoseScreenWasRedrawnMidReadDoesNotLand_S31_US58_AC4c (failed on main, passes). US-58 AC4c. Was: Path 6 of the S25 design (2026-11-13), left out of S25 on the owner's ruling. ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/RecordStore+Charts.swift chart(): the series stamp is (revision, draws); when draws moves during the engine call, stamp != self.stamp(series), so nothing is kept, but the chart is still returned and MetricRead lands it for the unchanged revision (MetricDetailView readChart). Repro: open the eGFR (creatinine) or waist-to-height page; while its read runs, move draws without a record change (a return to the foreground that redraws the plan for a new day, e.g. past midnight or an 18th birthday, RecordStore.redraw); the page's .task(id: store.revision) does not run again, so it keeps the stale landing until the next revision. US-58 AC4c, US-73 AC7
